facts.fact: Clay 偷偷用她前几天问过的那块木头雕了第二支桨，藏在小船座位底下
facts.anchor: A second oar—made from the piece of wood I had asked Clay about days ago.

facts.fact: 风暴里她以为岛真的消失了，要再等二十年才会回来
facts.anchor: Or maybe… it’s truly gone—slipped back into a ribbon of time, and it won’t return for another twenty years.

facts.fact: 她划回岸上，湿透地对他说：我走不了
facts.anchor: “I couldn’t leave,” I whisper, breathless, hair dripping down my shoulders.

facts.fact: 这块地是 Alice 家的，十英亩，祖传了三代
facts.anchor: Ten acres, been in her family for three generations.

facts.fact: 他说 1952 年那夜失去 Alice 是上天对他的惩罚
facts.anchor: “After it all happened, losing her, I knew it was punishment.”

facts.fact: 岛上先过去四个月，再过去一个月，日子过得数不清
facts.anchor: Four months pass, then five, the days skittering by like thin-legged insects, uncounted, unnoticed.

facts.fact: 他要她在旧生活和岛上的生活之间二选一
facts.anchor: “Ye don’t get to have both,” he says now.

facts.fact: 本章结尾海平线上出现一道微光
facts.anchor: But a shiver of light appears in the dark.
